body:
I tripped on roughly 25 grams High Hawaiians Magic Truffles, 2 days after tripping on 20 grams of Atlantis Magic Truffles. I want to detail my second trip.
I went to my favourite Headshop, to chill a bit, and ended up asking the clerk, if I would still feel something if I take truffles now, if I already took some 2 days before. The previous dose was 20 grams of Atlantis, which lead to a nice long trip. Closer to 6 hours, heavy visuals, mind bending realities, all that good stuff. The clerk said its unlikely, and I should wait a bit more. Since I didnt have the time, I thought it through, and figured hey, either I feel nothing and spent 30 bucks on it, or I get some small effects. I was happy with both outcomes, and went for it. As a bit of context, I tried Salvia the day before, but couldnt break through. This is to say Im not too afraid of being in other multiverses mentally.
Im not too afraid of being in other multiverses mentally.
I bought the box, and my trip sitter and I went strolling for a bit, until we reached a nice coffeeshop to hide from the sudden rain. I got a joint, she a space cake, and sat down at the shop. I had asked the clerk if I may eat the truffles here, and after getting the green light I opened the box and went for it. I had an empty stomach, and felt mentally ready to explore whatever it has to throw at me. Of course, I had in mind what I wanted to work on myself during the trip, but I thought its not in my control and to just enjoy it. This was the right call.
The truffles were quite small, and a lot of them, so I started munching. I made sure to grind them finely in my mouth, and kept them in my mouth for a bit. After 30 minutes, I had taken about 3/4th of the box, and decided to take a break. Pretty soon, the effects started to kick in.
The first thing I noticed was a slight chance in visuals. The shadows on the couch in front of me seemed to become more intense, the small details of the rocks on the walk behind the couch started to show some movement in them, but not too much. I could tell that things are happening, but I couldnt quite clarify yet what. I looked around more, and felt that my stomach started to get upset. I contemplated going outside for a breather, but then told my trip sitter I will quickly go to the toilet to see if I have to throw up. Good call, as soon as I reached the toilet I threw up straight into it. At first I wasnt sure if that was gonna end the trip, but while throwing up I knew nope, they are gonna have a proper effect. The toilet started to move a bit, as my vision started to become somewhat unfocused, and anything I was looking at just started to repeat itself. After cleaning up, I went back outside, sat down in my seat, and looked at my trip sitter. I let her know that it started and that I feel great. When I looked at her, her face started to multiply, move around, and swirl around. I could hold a conversation, but in my mind I was thinking, why do they play such weird music at this place, because any music just started to repeat itself constantly as if on loop.  Since the rain stopped, we decided to go for a walk.
We stepped outside, and I noticed that I could walk fine, but was definitely impaired. I looked at the ground while walking, and saw the cobblestone intensifying in colour and size. I had a change in perspective, and things felt further away then they were, while I felt tinier and tinier. I looked up, and saw the street repeating it self over it self multiple times. It was a cold and rainy day, so I colours looked more muted and faded, rather than intense. Talking became a bit harder, I lost some degree of control over my face, and it was pulled in some directions. Visually it was fine, I didnt actually move it, it just felt that way. Where most of the time you get a warm and cozy feeling with truffles, this time around I felt like a PC running Windows 95 on original hardware in 2024, which was trying its best to simultaneously keep up and shut down. Things started to melt, my vision kept repeating as when you move a stuck error message around, and I started to hear some shouting in the distance. The shouting was just random gibberish of cries of agony and pain, far off in the distance, something akin to what you would hear if you describe a vision of hell. At first a woman, sometimes repeating my name, sometimes just shouting, and later a man shouting more intensely. I wasnt sure if it was real or not, after all the city I was in was large and many things were happening all the time, but since my trip sitter didnt react to those, I figured out it was the truffles.
At this point, my mind shifted a bit into a somewhat more punishing mindset, for taking the truffles. The Clerk said dont do it, not a good idea, the internet says so, so why would you do this to yourself you f-ing Idiot. After a few minutes in this thought I realised that why am I so hard on myself, and to just let go and enjoy the trip. I never broke through on this trip visually, all my visuals were very grounded, but mentally I was simultaneously in many different universes, riding the edge of the cosmos, but still capable to walk around the mass of people around me and somewhat holding a conversation. I looked at the canals and the water near me, admiring that, when my trip sitter said let me take a picture of you. I just thought sure, doesnt really matter, Im both shutting down, and not even here, so why not. The noises a windows pc makes when not reacting started to keep coming up in my head, and if I thought too much on one topic it got shut down. I thought well then, time to just enjoy it. I looked at the box of truffles I had left, and ate most of them, leaving maybe a gram or less, and threw the box.
We then walked further, when my trip sitter asked what I wanted to do. Sitting down somewhere comfortable seemed like a good idea, so we managed to find a cafe and sit down there. I took an espresso, and started to have some very strong visuals. I looked out the window and the entire world outside kept moving and shifting, colours changing, no shape and size that I could recognise. I was quiet, but still managed to respond to the conversation going on. The shadows on the walls in front and behind of me were moving intensely in all sides and generally the world started to melt around me.
The screaming never stopped
The screaming never stopped
, and turned somewhat into the sounds of Seagulls and Whales that you can hear in Pink Floyds Echoes. I felt out of place and as if I was discovering an alien planet. I was still very much there in reality. The music in the cafe seemed like stuck in a loop, and I could only make out one or two words out of the same sentence over and over. We had a flight to catch, and managed to get ourselves into a cab to the airport. I was still tripping strong, but smilling the entire way.
At the airport, I looked at the time table of the flights, and all the digital numbers and letters started to melt, so I just gave up reading it. We had to go through security, and my trip changed from strong visual, to being balanced. I noticed a big smile on my face, not too big, just being in a good mood. I started to unpack my things at security, and decided its okay, Im tripping, but I will take my time and just do things smoothly and it will be fine. I felt total control over my actions, and I managed to do everything smoothly and without any hiccups. In my mind I was still outside of this universe somehow, but I felt absolute and total Zen. Waiting for my flight I still had some slight visuals, looking at a surface the design moved a bit, and my some colours seemed more intense.
I dont exactly recommend this to other people. Overall the second trip lasted for 4-5 hours, my first trip around 6-7. I understand why people recommended not to, but I also realised that I'm just insane and greatly enjoy punishing myself, so I had two of my favourite trips so far. 10/10, loved every second of it. Most people probably would not enjoy this, as it seemed being stuck and exploring an alien world or the place and time between life and death, as if your body was shutting down for hours, without any signs of entering either heaven or hell, roaming as a shapeless ghost in the void. I thought this is where most people would panic, but I reminded myself that I took truffles, on purpose, and that this is just that, and was happy as could be going on.
